narrative_prose: Silas squints into the swirling dark of the underground cavern. The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea rips the surface into jagged, impossible peaks, defying gravity in eerie silence. A heavy smell of ozone hangs in the stagnant air, biting the back of his throat. He adjusts his grip on his hammer. If they cannot stabilize the resonance before the next wave, the entire colony structure will succumb to the shearing forces.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The vast expanse of the cavern is dominated by the churning black mirror of the ferrofluid sea. The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea creates towering spikes that collapse just as quickly.

sensory_palette.sound: whooshing, cracking hum of magnetic fields

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be used to tune the local field and calm the sea.
Can be manipulated to draw metallic debris.
Can be harvested for its unique energy properties.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To assimilate all metallic objects in the vicinity.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Extending pseudopods of magnetic fluid to grasp and pull.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: It threatens to pull the structural supports of the walkway.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The anomaly will coalesce into a massive wave that washes over the entire platform.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The magnetic shear is destabilizing the local environment.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Silas needs to prove that intuitive leaps can solve problems beyond micrometer measurement.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The colony's survival depends on mastering the planet's magnetosphere.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Failure means the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea pulls the walkway supports, dropping them into the black depths.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Silas strikes a critical node, accelerating the shear.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The console sparks and burns Silas, but the field stabilizes temporarily.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Silas masterfully tunes the resonator, calming the sea.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Silas not only calms the sea but realizes a hidden pattern in the magnetic fluctuations.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Silas looks back toward the entrance, calling for Hector to bring the heavy lifter. What does Hector do?

drift_audit.corrective_authors_note: Silas is relying too heavily on raw intuition. He needs to ground his actions in measurable facts to re-align with his core traits.
